answer: A bond of 23% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in cedar, and tide reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 80 aliases, and each one needs its own funded haven account. The attacker spends 123 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
